outages.raw_text:
Load Center: Corozal. 
Feeder: 6.
Zone: 4 (portion).
Areas to be affected: the portion of Libertad Village from Central Avenue to Cow Pen Street and entire Egypt Street. 
Outage type: Scheduled.  
Purpose of outage: BEL to conduct power line upgrades and remove hazardous vegetation growing into power lines to improve the reliability of the power supply to our Customers.
